reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified: The gossip path calls verify_data_column_sidecar (peerdas_helpers.nim:352) which validates index < NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS at line 356. The sync path (request_manager.nim:190, validator_custody.nim:168) only calls verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof, bypassing index validation. Sidecars from sync are put into ColumnQuarantine (request_manager.nim:437), which calls getIndex (blob_quarantine.nim:237) performing unchecked array access indexMap[int(index)] on an array sized to NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS=128. With index >= 128, this causes out-of-bounds access. In Nimbus release builds (no bounds checking), this triggers undefined behavior: crash or memory corruption. Exploitable via single malicious P2P sync response from untrusted peer. Spec reference: 01e file outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json line 209-224, invariant 'sidecar.index must be in range [0, NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS) to be accepted'. Code violates this requirement on sync path. Severity: Single-packet crash affecting Nimbus-only nodes (estimated 5-10% network share), meets Medium threshold 'Bring down more than 5% of the network by sending a single network packet'.
